iv.validity: Exclusion/independence/monotonicity not testable from first stage; F is a heuristic, not validity proof.

effect.inference: Strong-IV asymptotic delta CI using joint outcome/treatment covariance; not weak-IV robust

causal_analysis.estimand: Wald LATE among compliers under valid binary instrument, exclusion and monotonicity
